entries.source: BayHStA, Jesuitenorden, Kolleg St. Paul Regensburg Urkunden 1852
entries.summary:
Schuldbrief von Hans Leyrer, Müller auf der mittleren Mühle zu Rosenberg, und seiner Ehefrau Margarethe für Philipp Kemnater zu Hohenkemnath über 30 Rhein. Gulden nicht bezahlter Zinsen und Gülten auf einigen Äckern, die ihnen der Kemnater außerhalb der Mühle überlassen hat, gemäß der mit dem Kemnater erfolgten Verrechnung im Beisein von Georg Pirckner zu Gebertshofen (Gebershoff) und Martin Ludwig von Rosenberg.
S1: Hans Poppenberger, Landschreiber zu Sulzbach, S2: Georg Pirckner zu Gerbertshofen (Gebershoff)

entries.english: I, Hanns Leyrer, miller at Rosenberg on the middle mill, publicly acknowledge with this letter, and I, Margaretha, his lawful wife, humbly acknowledge with this open letter, for ourselves and all our heirs and descendants, that we have rightfully become indebted [?] […] to the noble and steadfast Philipp von Kembnat[…] [?] Hohenkemnat [?], his heirs and descendants, namely thirty Rhenish guilders of the land's currency, of interest and dues [?], on account of several fields that the said Kemnater left to us outside the mill, and which we have repaired [?]; and everything was settled and reckoned in money with us on […] St. Nicholas's day [?] of the nineteenth [?] year, in the presence of Jorg Pirckner of Gebershoff and Martin Ludwig von Rosenberg, according to his drawn-up note [?], together with the grace and remission that the aforesaid Kemnater has granted us. We promise for ourselves and all our heirs, by virtue of this letter, to pay the said Kemnater and his heirs the said sum, and to begin payment on the next St. Michael's day after the date of this letter. […] the mill is pledged as security and further pledge […]. […] Pappenperger, Landschreiber zu Sulzbach, and Jorg Pirckner of Gebershoff, have been asked to hang their seals to this letter […]

facts.content: was miller at the middle mill at Rosenberg.

settled accounts with Philipp Kemnater in the presence of Georg Pirckner zu Gebershoff and Martin Ludwig von Rosenberg.
pledged the middle mill at Rosenberg as security to Philipp Kemnater.
